newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bomb explodes outside home of Iranian in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes outside home of Iranian in Cyprus.

text.p: A small bomb exploded causing minimal damage outside the home of an Iranian millionaire living in Cyprus's capital Nicosia on Thursday morning police said.
"It was a small improvised device which exploded on the pavement," a police spokesman told Reuters. "Some damage was caused to the pavement and a window was shattered."
He said the owner of the house, Iranian Hossein Alikhani, 52, "does not suspect anyone."
